requirement.statement: EditorPlan SHALL carry typed, serializable, renderer-neutral metadata sufficient to render schema fields without reopening raw StructureSchema or embedding component/runtime implementations.

case.given: A nested schema with field labels, required keys, constraints, scalar enum/const/default, collection/map hints, union alternatives/discriminator, and refs
case.when: The default compiler creates an EditorPlan
case.then: Each relevant plan node SHALL expose the corresponding typed facts and SHALL pass contract validation

case.given: A schema or plan attempts to carry a factory, component, runtime instance, or writer in metadata
case.then: The validator SHALL reject the non-serializable or ownership-violating value

requirement.statement: Collection, map, and union plans SHALL preserve the pure-data facts needed for dynamic item creation, stable rendering, key editing, and alternative selection without snapshot expansion.

case.given: An array schema with nested item schema, serializable item default, and identity hint
case.when: The schema is compiled before a value snapshot exists
case.then: The collection plan SHALL retain one wildcard item template plus default and identity facts, and SHALL NOT create static value children

case.given: A union schema with discriminator and labeled alternatives
case.then: The union plan SHALL preserve ordered alternative descriptors separately from recursively compiled alternative plans

requirement.statement: The compiler SHALL normalize recursive and path-targeted EditorPresentation overlays with deterministic precedence before transformer selection and recursion.

case.given: Recursive presentation data and multiple path-targeted overlays address the same nested field or wildcard template
case.when: The compiler normalizes and compiles the presentation
case.then: Unspecified data SHALL survive, matching later path overlays SHALL win per field, and all transformers SHALL observe the normalized overlay

case.given: A caller compiles a schema with path overlays
case.then: Normalization SHALL remain compiler-owned and SHALL NOT add functions, resolver aliases, or precedence controls to caller config

requirement.statement: The render/runtime prerequisite revision SHALL remain inside contract and logic ownership and SHALL NOT implement renderer, host session, persistence, XNL, VFS, or Flow semantics.

case.given: The revised contract and compiler source graph
case.then: The packages SHALL expose stable root APIs and SHALL contain no Vue, Element Plus, support runtime, IO, XNL, VFS, database, or Flow imports
